text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Alfred Sant in Sweden for meeting of European Social Democratic parties.

- Maltese tourism authorities plan historic re-enactments next year to mark the 200th anniversary since French troops under Napoleon occupied Malta. The occupation lasted two years and ended with a Maltese insurrection assisted by Admiral Nelson.

- Police Commissioner meets fireworks manufacturers who are angry that the police have started enforcing a law barring the letting off of fireworks within 200 metres off a residential area. It was agreed that the police will hold inspections of sites where the fireworks are let off.

- Talks yet to start on new Air Malta collective agreement, even though the current one is about to expire. The talks are expected to be tough, given the state-owned airline's worsening financial position.
